schema: medsync.lab-catalogue.v2 (test menu catalogue; additions to v1)
status: PROPOSAL. Concepts and tests import as a signed addendum (lab lead + CSO). Sections are recommendations each hospital may override. No ranges or critical limits.

tests.container: New, clean, dry glass tube, no additive

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Bedside test for venom-induced coagulopathy, used to decide on and repeat antivenom; often done by the clinician at the bedside. Plastic tubes give false 'not clotted' results. No LOINC term. HC III as the lowest level is a judgement.

tests.container: Sodium citrate 3.2% (light blue top), filled to the line

orderLoinc.longName: aPTT in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay

tests.notes: Ordered alone for unfractionated heparin monitoring and haemophilia screening. Reuses v1 concept obs.aptt.

orderLoinc.longName: Bleeding time

tests.advisory: Obsolete; poor predictor of bleeding. Kept for labs still asked for it.
tests.notes: Obsolete. It is poorly reproducible, operator-dependent and does not predict surgical bleeding; prefer a platelet count, coagulation screen and history. It is listed only because 'Bleeding Time Test' is still on Ugandan request forms. Consider hiding it from default menus.

tests.display: Body fluid cell count and differential (pleural, ascitic, synovial)
tests.specimen: Pleural, ascitic (peritoneal), synovial or pericardial fluid - select at order
tests.container: EDTA (purple top) for cell count; separate sterile container for culture
tests.notes: One order with the fluid type chosen at request time, rather than one test per fluid. Concepts use the LOINC 'Body fluid' system. Synovial fluid crystal examination and fluid chemistry (protein, LDH, albumin, glucose) are separate. No order-level panel LOINC was verified.

tests.specimen: Bone marrow aspirate (posterior iliac crest; tibia in infants)
tests.container: Air-dried glass slides plus EDTA (purple top) for extra studies

orderLoinc.longName: Bone marrow aspiration report

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: A procedure rather than a specimen referral: the patient usually goes to Mulago NRH haematology, UCI (adult/paediatric oncology) or a large private or mission hospital. An RRH with a physician/paediatrician may do the aspirate and send slides to a pathology lab. The trephine biopsy belongs to histopathology_cytology. 'Bone Marrow Test' is on the UgandaEMR form. referTo is left null because no listed referral lab receives the specimen.

tests.specimen: Venous whole blood (capillary for point-of-care PIMA/FACSPresto)

orderLoinc.longName: T-cell helper (CD4) subset panel - Blood

tests.notes: Recommended section: haematology. Reasoning: CD4 is a cell count (flow cytometry, or point-of-care PIMA/FACSPresto) on the same EDTA blood as the FBC, done by staff trained in cell counting. It is not serology. The brief's immunology_serology section is for antibody/antigen work, autoimmune tests and immunoglobulins. In Ugandan labs the CD4 machine usually sits on or next to the haematology bench, or in the ART clinic lab. Tenants that run it in an HIV/immunology room can override. CD4% is mainly used in children under 5. Proposed restricted='hiv' because a CD4 request implies HIV status; the CSO decides. Panel 65758-5 lists absolute CD4 as required and CD4% as conditional, which matches the v1 components.

orderLoinc.longName: Clotting time of Blood by Lee White method

tests.advisory: Lee-White clotting time is obsolete; 20WBCT is the snakebite bedside test.
tests.notes: Obsolete and insensitive; replaced by PT/APTT. It is listed because 'Clotting Time Test' is on the UgandaEMR form. For snakebite use test.wbct20 instead.

tests.container: Sodium citrate 3.2% (light blue top), filled to the line

orderLoinc.longName: PT and aPTT panel - Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay

tests.notes: Matches 'Coagulation Profile' and 'Clotting Panel' on the UgandaEMR request form. Fibrinogen is a separate add-on order (test.fibrinogen), not part of this panel, because most RRH labs do not stock Clauss reagent.

tests.container: Sterile universal container or plain tube (count within 1 hour)

levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Counting chamber, then a stained cytospin or smear for the differential. In many Ugandan labs the CSF count is done at the microbiology bench together with Gram stain, India ink and CrAg; tenants may move the section. CSF chemistry (protein, glucose) belongs to clinical_chemistry. No order-level panel LOINC was verified. 'CSF Examination' is on the UgandaEMR form.

tests.specimen: Citrated platelet-poor plasma (some POC devices take whole blood)
tests.container: Sodium citrate 3.2% (light blue top), filled to the line

orderLoinc.longName: Fibrin D-dimer FEU [Mass/volume] in Platelet poor plasma

tests.notes: Report the FEU or DDU basis exactly as the kit does (v1 has both obs.d_dimer and obs.d_dimer_ddu). Many RRHs use point-of-care fluorescence immunoassay readers. Availability varies, so the level is a judgement.

tests.container: Sodium citrate 3.8% (black top, Westergren) or EDTA (purple top) diluted per method

orderLoinc.longName: Erythrocyte [Sedimentation Rate] in Blood by Westergren method

tests.notes: Manual Westergren in most public labs ('Sedimentation Test' on the UgandaEMR form). Set it up within 4 hours and read at exactly 60 minutes, upright and out of direct sunlight.

tests.specimen: Citrated platelet-poor plasma (double-spun, frozen if transported)
tests.container: Sodium citrate 3.2% (light blue top), filled to the line

orderLoinc.longName: Coagulation factor IX activity actual/normal in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay

tests.notes: As for factor VIII. Neonatal FIX is physiologically low, so interpret with age.

tests.specimen: Citrated platelet-poor plasma (double-spun, frozen if transported)
tests.container: Sodium citrate 3.2% (light blue top), filled to the line

orderLoinc.longName: Coagulation factor VIII activity actual/normal in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay

tests.notes: Haemophilia diagnosis is centred at Mulago NRH haematology; private labs refer out, sometimes abroad. Send frozen plasma; it is unstable at room temperature. Level and route are judgements.

tests.container: Sodium citrate 3.2% (light blue top), filled to the line

orderLoinc.longName: Fibrinogen [Mass/volume] in Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay

tests.notes: Needed for postpartum haemorrhage, DIC and decisions on cryoprecipitate. It is available on coagulation analysers that stock Clauss reagent (Mulago, private labs). Level and route are judgements.

orderLoinc.longName: CBC W Auto Differential panel - Blood

tests.notes: Component list unchanged from v1. It covers both 5-part analysers (full differential) and 3-part analysers (mid and granulocyte cells); each analyser fills only its own lines. The order code is the automated-differential panel. 'Full Hemogram', 'CBC (auto)' and 'CBC' all appear on the UgandaEMR HMIS-LAB-001 request form. HC IV as the lowest level is a judgement: many HC IVs have a 3-part analyser.

orderLoinc.longName: Glucose-6-Phosphate dehydrogenase [Enzymatic activity/mass] in Red Blood Cells

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Rarely available in Uganda; it confirms heterozygous females and intermediate screens. A quantitative biosensor that also gives Hb could make it a point-of-care test. The route is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Glucose-6-Phosphate dehydrogenase [Presence] in Red Blood Cells

tests.notes: Mainly ordered for neonatal jaundice and drug-induced haemolysis work-ups. 'G6PD' is on the UgandaEMR form, but most public labs do not stock it; private labs (Lancet, MBN and others) run or refer it. Repeat 2-3 months after a haemolytic episode. Level and route are judgements.

orderLoinc.longName: Hemoglobin [Mass/volume] in Blood

tests.notes: Single Hb for ANC, pre-transfusion checks and anaemia screening, usually done on a point-of-care photometer (HemoCue type). Reuses v1 concept obs.haemoglobin (method-neutral LOINC 718-7). 'Hemoglobin Only' is on the UgandaEMR form.

orderLoinc.longName: Hemoglobin panel - Blood by HPLC

levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Capillary electrophoresis or HPLC at Mulago/referral and private labs; CPHL confirms sickle cell disease within the national programme. The order code is HPLC-specific; component concepts are method-neutral so either method maps. HbF and HbS % are used to monitor hydroxyurea and transfusion. HbA2 ranges depend on the method and kit. 'HBG With Electrophoresis' is on the UgandaEMR form. referTo CPHL is a judgement for public facilities; private labs refer to their own hubs.

tests.specimen: Dried blood spot (heel or finger prick)
tests.container: DBS filter card (as used for EID)

orderLoinc.longName: Hemoglobins that can be presumptively identified based on available controls in DBS

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: The national programme screens newborns and children under 2 on DBS sent through the EID sample-transport (hub) network to CPHL, which tests by isoelectric focusing. Positives are confirmed at CPHL with the same technology (S3). CPHL now has an automated IEF gel scanner, with CONSA newborn screening sites at Jinja and Lira RRHs (S4). Collection happens at the facility; testing is central only.

tests.container: Sodium citrate 3.2% (light blue top), filled to the line

orderLoinc.longName: Lupus anticoagulant aPTT and dRVVT screening panel W Reflex

tests.notes: Referral only: private labs send it on, often abroad. It is used for recurrent pregnancy loss and unexplained thrombosis. Do not test on anticoagulants (especially DOACs and warfarin) without discussing with the lab. The lupus-sensitive APTT member is not modelled separately; add it if a referral lab reports it.

tests.container: Heparinised capillary tube, or EDTA (purple top)

orderLoinc.longName: Hematocrit [Volume Fraction] of Blood by Centrifugation

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Manual microhaematocrit. Still used in paediatric and dengue/VHF monitoring and where there is no analyser. The level is a judgement.

tests.specimen: Venous whole blood (film made within 2-3 hours)
tests.notes: Thin film, Leishman/Giemsa/Field stain. This is the morphology film, not the malaria film (test.malaria_smear). No order-level LOINC panel was verified; 18314-5 (the comment concept) can be used as the order code if one is needed. 'RBC Morphology Test' is on the UgandaEMR form. A GH as the lowest level is a judgement: it needs a trained technologist.

tests.container: Sodium citrate 3.2% (light blue top), filled to the line

orderLoinc.longName: PT panel - Platelet poor plasma by Coagulation assay

levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: No separate 'PT alone' test is added: analysers always report PT with INR, and Ugandan forms list 'Prothrombin Time (with INR)'. Process within 4 hours of collection; an under-filled tube gives a falsely long PT. The INR depends on the thromboplastin's ISI, so ranges come from the kit. RRH as the lowest level is a judgement; some GHs and private labs at lower levels have point-of-care INR meters.

orderLoinc.longName: Reticulocytes/Erythrocytes in Blood

tests.notes: Usually a manual supravital stain. The absolute count is calculated when the lab gives an RBC count. No two-component panel code was verified, so the % term is used as the order code.

tests.specimen: Capillary (heel or finger prick) or venous whole blood
tests.container: Direct capillary sample to test device; or EDTA (purple top)

orderLoinc.longName: Hemoglobin pattern [Interpretation] in Blood

tests.notes: Lateral-flow immunoassay that detects HbA, HbS and HbC, so it gives AA/AS/SS/SC/AC/CC and works in newborns. MoH has promoted point-of-care testing where central IEF screening is hard to reach (S4). Positive results are confirmed by CPHL (IEF) or by HPLC/electrophoresis. No rapid-immunoassay-specific LOINC term was found, so the method-neutral pattern term is used. The level is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Hemoglobin S [Presence] in Blood

tests.notes: A screening test only: it cannot tell trait from disease and is unreliable in infants under 6 months (high HbF). Prefer test.sickle_poc where HemoTypeSC-type kits are stocked. 'Sickling Test Only' is on the UgandaEMR form. The level is a judgement.

tests.container: Sodium citrate 3.2% (light blue top), filled to the line

orderLoinc.longName: Thrombin time

tests.notes: Rarely ordered on its own; used for a prolonged APTT or PT, heparin contamination and fibrinogen disorders. The level is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: ABO and Rh group [Type] in Blood

tests.notes: Tile/tube or gel-card forward grouping with antisera, plus reverse grouping where reagent cells are available. HC IVs with a theatre run it for caesarean sections and in ANC. 'Blood Grouping Test' is on the UgandaEMR form.

tests.specimen: Cord blood (from the placental end of the cord, not Wharton's jelly-contaminated)

orderLoinc.longName: ABO and Rh group panel - Cord blood

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: For babies of RhD-negative mothers (decides anti-D for the mother) and for suspected HDN or ABO incompatibility. The order code covers ABO/Rh only; the DAT member is the cord-specific DAT term 51871-2. Wash cord cells well (Wharton's jelly causes false agglutination). The level is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Direct antiglobulin test.polyspecific reagent [Presence] on Red Blood Cells

tests.notes: Polyspecific AHG first. Monospecific IgG and C3d only if it is positive and the reagents are stocked (often only at NRH or private labs). Used for suspected autoimmune haemolysis, transfusion reaction and haemolytic disease of the newborn. 'Coombs Test' is on the UgandaEMR form without saying direct or indirect, so the menu should offer both.

tests.specimen: Venous whole blood (sample taken within 72 hours of transfusion if transfused or pregnant in the last 3 months)
tests.container: EDTA (purple top); some blood banks also want a plain (red top) clotted sample

orderLoinc.longName: Blood type and Crossmatch panel - Blood

tests.notes: This is how Ugandan clinicians order blood ('GXM, 2 units'). The request carries the number of units and the component. The hospital blood bank regroups the patient and each UBTS unit, then crossmatches. The donor-unit lines repeat per unit. LOINC panel 34531-4 lists the antibody screen as required, but it is often not done in Uganda; order test.group_and_save as well when screening cells are available. Blood comes screened for TTIs from UBTS regional blood banks (Arua, Gulu, Fort Portal, Hoima, Masaka, Mbale, Soroti, Mbarara, Nakasero) (S5). HC IVs with theatres crossmatch on site.

tests.display: Group and save (ABO, RhD, antibody screen)

orderLoinc.longName: Blood type and Indirect antibody screen panel - Blood

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Pre-operative and antenatal. Many Ugandan hospital blood banks do not stock screening cells and go straight to group and crossmatch. Where screening is unavailable, a positive or problem sample goes to UBTS (Nakasero) for red-cell serology; this is a judgement because UBTS's reference service menu was not verified. RRH as the level is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Blood group antibody screen [Presence] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: The Ugandan clinician's order for an RhD-negative pregnant woman (before anti-D, and at 28 weeks). It reuses the same antibody-screen concept as group and save (it is the same IAT measurement) and adds a titre when positive. Titration and antibody identification usually go to the NRH, a private lab or UBTS. This is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Glucose [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma --2 hours post meal

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Common in Ugandan diabetes clinics for monitoring. Not a WHO diagnostic test. Usually done on a glucometer at HC III level. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Creatinine renal clearance in 24 hour Urine and Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Serum creatinine must be taken during the collection. Used where eGFR is unreliable (extremes of muscle mass, pregnancy, amputees). minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Protein [Mass/time] in 24 hour Urine

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Collection errors are common; uPCR is usually better. Give the patient written collection instructions. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Corticotropin [Moles/volume] in Plasma

tests.notes: Preanalytically demanding: take with a morning cortisol, keep on ice, centrifuge cold within 1-2 h, freeze. Usually shipped by private labs to external reference labs.

orderLoinc.longName: Adenosine deaminase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Pleural fluid

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Supports TB pleuritis where pleural biopsy and culture are slow. The cut-off depends on the kit. ADA in ascitic fluid or CSF would need its own concept. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Albumin [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Ordered alone for nephrotic syndrome, SAAG with an ascitic tap, and nutrition. Bromocresol green method on most Ugandan analysers.

tests.container: EDTA (purple), keep at room temperature (do not chill)

orderLoinc.longName: Aldosterone and renin concentration panel - Plasma

tests.notes: Mid-morning sample after 2 h upright, after correcting hypokalaemia. Record antihypertensives (ACE-i/ARB, diuretics, beta-blockers affect it). Chilling falsely raises renin (cryoactivation). Panel code is for direct renin concentration.

orderLoinc.longName: Alpha-1-Fetoprotein [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Used for HCC surveillance (HBV is common in Uganda) and germ-cell tumours. Not for antenatal screening.

orderLoinc.longName: Mullerian inhibiting substance [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Fertility centres and private labs. Can be taken any day of the cycle. Results differ markedly between kits.

tests.container: EDTA (purple) or lithium heparin (green), on ice, analysed within 30 minutes

orderLoinc.longName: Ammonia [Moles/volume] in Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Hepatic encephalopathy, Reye-like illness, inborn errors. The sample is unstable, so a result after a long referral delay is unreliable. minLevel is a judgement.

tests.container: Plain (red), yellow/gold SST or lithium heparin (green)

orderLoinc.longName: Amylase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: For pancreatitis. Lipase is more specific where available. minLevel is a judgement.

tests.container: Sterile universal container (fluid); plain (red)/yellow SST for paired serum

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: SAAG needs a same-day serum albumin (included). Glucose and LDH help separate secondary from spontaneous bacterial peritonitis. Relevant to the large burden of portal hypertension (schistosomiasis, hepatitis B) and TB peritonitis in Uganda. No single LOINC panel, so orderLoinc is null. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Beta-2-Microglobulin [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: For myeloma ISS staging (with albumin) and lymphoma prognosis at UCI. Sent to private labs where not available in-house.

orderLoinc.longName: Choriogonadotropin [Units/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: For ectopic/miscarriage follow-up (48 h serial values), molar pregnancy/GTN monitoring and germ-cell tumours. Serial values must use the same lab and kit. Distinct from the qualitative urine test (test.pregnancy_urine). Level is a judgement (see gaps).

levelBasis.entry: AST, ALT, ALP, total and direct bilirubin

tests.notes: Adult or child bilirubin ordered without full LFTs. For neonates use test.bilirubin_neonatal. Protect from light. minLevel is a judgement.

tests.specimen: Arterial, venous or capillary whole blood (sample type recorded on the specimen)
tests.container: Pre-heparinised blood gas syringe; capillary tube for neonates

orderLoinc.longName: Gas panel - Blood

tests.notes: One test for arterial and venous gases; the sample type goes on the specimen and must show on the report. The analyser (i-STAT cartridges, ABL, GEM, epoc) decides which components are reported; blank components are not errors. Whole-blood Na/K/glucose/lactate have their own concepts so they are not trended with lab serum values. Analyse within 15 minutes, no air bubbles. Available where an RRH has a functioning ICU/HDU analyser and cartridges; a judgement.

tests.specimen: Capillary or venous whole blood (meter) or serum (lab)
tests.container: Finger prick to meter strip; or plain (red)/yellow SST

orderLoinc.longName: Beta hydroxybutyrate [Moles/volume] in Blood

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Preferred over urine ketones for diagnosing and monitoring DKA. Strip supply is the limiting factor in Uganda. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Natriuretic peptide B [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Less common than NT-proBNP in Uganda. Not interchangeable with NT-proBNP. minLevel is a judgement.
UK-style profile used by Ugandan private labs and NRHs. Magnesium is ordered separately. The ALP range is age-dependent and comes from the kit. No LOINC panel exists, so orderLoinc is null.

orderLoinc.longName: C peptide [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Classifies diabetes (type 1 vs type 2 vs atypical, e.g. in young Ugandans) and investigates hypoglycaemia. Pair with glucose.

orderLoinc.longName: C reactive protein [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Quantitative on chemistry or POC fluorescence analysers. Some labs still run semi-quantitative latex slide CRP; enter the titre-derived value in mg/L and mention the method in the comment. For cardiovascular risk use test.hs_crp. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Cancer Ag 15-3 [Units/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Metastatic breast cancer monitoring only; not for diagnosis or screening.

orderLoinc.longName: Cancer Ag 19-9 [Units/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Pancreatic/biliary cancer monitoring. Falsely raised in obstructive jaundice.

orderLoinc.longName: Cancer Ag 125 [Units/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Ovarian mass work-up (RMI) and monitoring. Raised in menstruation, endometriosis, PID, ascites, TB peritonitis.

orderLoinc.longName: Ceruloplasmin [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Unexplained liver disease or neuropsychiatric signs in young people (Wilson disease). Few Ugandan referral labs offer it; usually sent out of country (judgement).

orderLoinc.longName: Calcium [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Albumin from the same sample is needed to work out adjusted calcium. Avoid EDTA contamination (false low calcium). minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: carBAMazepine [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Trough sample, at least 2 weeks after starting (auto-induction). minLevel is a judgement.

tests.container: Plain (red), yellow/gold SST or lithium heparin (green), as the kit specifies

levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: A lab reports only the component its platform measures: hs-TnI or hs-TnT (immunoassay), or contemporary cTnI from POC fluorescence analysers (obs.troponin_i, added in v2). The three are not interchangeable; cut-offs come from the kit. No single order code covers all three, so orderLoinc is null. A qualitative cassette is test.troponin_i_rapid. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Carcinoembryonic Ag [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Colorectal cancer baseline and follow-up. Use the same lab for serial values.

orderLoinc.longName: Cholinesterase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Organophosphate and carbamate poisoning is common in Uganda (agricultural pesticides, self-harm), but serum cholinesterase is rarely available, and treatment with atropine must never wait for it. More useful for confirmation and for suxamethonium apnoea. Units vary between kits (U/L or kU/L). minLevel is a judgement.

tests.container: Plain (red), yellow/gold SST or lithium heparin (green)

levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Still widely ordered in Uganda alongside or instead of troponin. A lab reports only the component its method gives: activity (U/L, immunoinhibition on chemistry analysers) or mass (ug/L, immunoassay/POC). The two have different LOINC codes, so orderLoinc is null. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Cortisol [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: One orderable item; the collection time on the specimen says whether it is morning (08:00-09:00) or random. Prednisolone cross-reacts with most immunoassays; hydrocortisone must be withheld before sampling. Level is a judgement (see gaps).

tests.container: Plain (red), yellow/gold SST or lithium heparin (green)

orderLoinc.longName: Creatine kinase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Rhabdomyolysis (crush injury, snakebite, heat stroke), myositis. minLevel is a judgement.

tests.container: Plain (red), yellow/gold SST or lithium heparin (green)

orderLoinc.longName: Creatinine [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Ordered alone for ART (tenofovir) monitoring and for drug dosing. eGFR is computed from creatinine, age and sex. minLevel is a judgement.

tests.container: Sterile universal container (CSF); fluoride oxalate (grey) for paired plasma glucose

orderLoinc.longName: Protein and Glucose panel - Cerebrospinal Fluid

levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Ordered with CSF microscopy, CrAg and culture (other strands). Take a paired blood glucose; the ratio is calculated when it exists. Analyse quickly; glucose falls in a cell-rich CSF. minLevel is a judgement (glucose by glucometer is sometimes used at GH; protein needs an analyser).

orderLoinc.longName: Digoxin [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Take at least 6 hours after the dose. Interpret with potassium. minLevel is a judgement (Uganda Heart Institute / private).

orderLoinc.longName: Fasting glucose [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: After an 8-hour fast. At HC III and below it is usually done on a glucometer; the result still files here when the order was 'FBS'. minLevel is a judgement.

levelBasis.entry: FSH and LH; progesterone; testosterone; oestrogen
levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Mirrors how Ugandan private labs and gynaecology clinics order it. Contents vary by lab, so hospitals may edit membership. Progesterone is only meaningful at mid-luteal phase (day 21). No LOINC panel code.

orderLoinc.longName: Ferritin [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: The most-ordered iron test. Often run on FIA/immunoassay analysers. Falsely reassuring during infection/inflammation. Level is a judgement (see gaps).

orderLoinc.longName: Folate [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Fasting, non-haemolysed, protected from light. Take before transfusion or folic acid.

orderLoinc.longName: Triiodothyronine (T3) Free [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.entry: Thyroid function (TSH, free T3, free T4, total T3, total T4)
levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Ordered alone when T3 toxicosis is suspected (suppressed TSH, normal FT4). Level is a judgement (see gaps).

orderLoinc.longName: Thyroxine (T4) free [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.entry: Thyroid function (TSH, free T3, free T4, total T3, total T4)
levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Ordered alone for antithyroid-drug titration, early carbimazole follow-up, or central hypothyroidism where TSH is unreliable. Level is a judgement (see gaps).

orderLoinc.longName: Follitropin [Units/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.entry: FSH and LH; progesterone; testosterone; oestrogen
levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Day 2-5 of the cycle for ovarian reserve; record LMP on the request.

orderLoinc.longName: Follitropin and Lutropin panel [Units/volume] - Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.entry: FSH and LH; progesterone; testosterone; oestrogen
levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Commonly ordered together in infertility, PCOS (LH:FSH) and amenorrhoea work-up.

orderLoinc.longName: Somatotropin [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: A random GH is rarely useful. Acromegaly needs IGF-1 plus OGTT suppression; deficiency needs stimulation tests (endocrinologist-led). Often sent out of country by private labs.

orderLoinc.longName: Haptoglobin [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Haemolysis work-up (with LDH, bilirubin, reticulocytes). Low values can be normal in some people of African descent (anhaptoglobinaemia), so interpret with care. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Hemoglobin A1c/Hemoglobin.total in Blood

levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: POC HbA1c analysers are now common in NCD clinics at GH/RRH. Reported in % (NGSP); some analysers also give mmol/mol (IFCC). Unreliable with sickle cell disease, recent transfusion or severe anaemia. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: C reactive protein [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma by High sensitivity method

tests.notes: Cardiovascular risk only. For infection use test.crp. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Insulin [Units/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Pair with a simultaneous glucose (HOMA-IR, hypoglycaemia work-up). Exogenous insulin cross-reactivity varies by kit.

orderLoinc.longName: Calcium.ionized [Moles/volume] in Blood

tests.notes: Run on a blood gas or ISE analyser, anaerobically and without delay. Available where an RRH has an ICU blood gas analyser; otherwise referred. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Iron panel - Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Morning fasting sample, no haemolysis. Transferrin saturation is calculated by MedSync. The LOINC iron panel lists transferrin rather than TIBC, but is the closest order code. Interpret ferritin with CRP. Level is a judgement (see gaps).

tests.container: Fluoride oxalate (grey) on ice, or heparinised syringe for a blood gas analyser

orderLoinc.longName: Lactate [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Used in sepsis and severe malaria. In Uganda it is most often a handheld meter or a blood gas analyser result on whole blood; whole-blood lactate from a gas panel files as obs.bg_lactate. Analyse within 15 minutes or on ice. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Lactate dehydrogenase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma by Lactate to pyruvate reaction

levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Haemolysis, lymphoma/Burkitt's (tumour lysis risk), Light's criteria, PCP. Haemolysed samples are rejected. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Lutropin [Units/volume] in Serum or Plasma

orderLoinc.longName: Lipase [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Preferred pancreatitis marker, but the reagent is less common than amylase at RRH level; usually Mulago/private. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Lipid 1996 panel - Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.entry: Lipids: total cholesterol and triglycerides HC IV; LDL and HDL RRH
levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Fasting is no longer required for most purposes, but many Ugandan labs still ask for it; record fasting status. LDL is usually calculated (Friedewald); direct LDL is obs.chol_ldl_direct. The LOINC order code lists mass-unit members; it is used only as the order code. minLevel is a judgement.

tests.container: Plain (red) or yellow/gold SST, never lithium heparin (green)

orderLoinc.longName: Lithium [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: 12-hour post-dose sample. Order with U&E and thyroid tests. Lithium heparin tubes give a falsely high result, so the UI should block green tops. minLevel is a judgement (Butabika).

orderLoinc.longName: Hepatic function 2000 panel - Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.entry: AST, ALT, ALP, total and direct bilirubin

tests.notes: Ordered as one panel. The LOINC order code has no GGT and lists mass-unit bilirubin members; it is used only as the order code, and the components keep their SI concepts. Enzyme ranges depend on method and temperature, so they come from the kit insert. Some smaller labs run only ALT/AST for ART monitoring. minLevel is a judgement.

tests.container: Plain (red), yellow/gold SST or lithium heparin (green)

orderLoinc.longName: Magnesium [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Also used to monitor magnesium sulphate in pre-eclampsia, although clinical monitoring is the norm in Uganda. Haemolysis falsely raises it. minLevel is a judgement.

levelBasis.entry: FSH and LH; progesterone; testosterone; oestrogen
levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Morning sample for testosterone. Often ordered with semen analysis. No LOINC panel code.

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Separate order because the sample, urgency and phototherapy charts are neonatal. Total bilirubin is plotted on the phototherapy/exchange chart; direct (conjugated) bilirubin is needed for prolonged jaundice (>14 days) to pick up cholestasis/biliary atresia. A bedside bilirubinometer gives total only. Uses the same concepts as adult bilirubin. minLevel is a judgement.

tests.container: Plain (red), yellow/gold SST or EDTA (purple), as the kit specifies

orderLoinc.longName: Natriuretic peptide.B prohormone N-Terminal [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Heart failure. Done at Uganda Heart Institute / Mulago and large private labs; POC fluorescence kits are spreading. Age-specific cut-offs come from the kit. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Estradiol (E2) [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.entry: FSH and LH; progesterone; testosterone; oestrogen
levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Record cycle day. Not suitable for monitoring aromatase inhibitors (low-level immunoassay is unreliable).

tests.display: OGTT in pregnancy, 75 g (0, 1 and 2 hours)

orderLoinc.longName: Glucose tolerance 2 hours gestational panel - Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Gestational diabetes screening at 24-28 weeks; one abnormal value of the three is diagnostic. Kept separate from the non-pregnant OGTT because the time points and criteria differ. The LOINC gestational panel codes the baseline as 14996-3 ('pre 75 g glucose PO'); MedSync reuses obs.glucose_fasting (14771-0) per catalogue rules and maps it on export. Often glucometer-based at HC IV ANC clinics. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Glucose tolerance 2 hours panel - Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Non-pregnant adults (WHO diagnosis of diabetes / impaired glucose tolerance). The fasting sample reuses obs.glucose_fasting. The LOINC panel uses generic 'post XXX challenge' members; the 75 g-specific 2-hour code is used for the component. Often done on glucometers at lower levels; record the method. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Acetaminophen [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Take at 4 hours or later after ingestion and record the time of ingestion. Rarely available in Uganda; do not delay N-acetylcysteine for it. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Parathyrin.intact [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Order with calcium, phosphate and creatinine (CKD-MBD, hypercalcaemia). Separate promptly.

orderLoinc.longName: Phenytoin [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Trough sample. Low albumin raises the free fraction, so interpret total phenytoin with albumin. minLevel is a judgement.

tests.container: Plain (red), yellow/gold SST or lithium heparin (green)

orderLoinc.longName: Phosphate [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Important in refeeding syndrome (severe acute malnutrition, SAM) and DKA. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Metanephrine.free and Normetanephrine.free panel [Moles/volume] - Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Supine sample after 20-30 min rest is ideal. LC-MS/MS or ELISA, shipped out by private labs. A 24 h urine metanephrines test is the alternative where plasma is not offered (not modelled here).

tests.container: Sterile universal container (fluid); heparinised syringe for pH; plain (red)/yellow SST for paired serum

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Exudate vs transudate by Light's criteria needs a paired serum protein and LDH, which are included. pH only if a blood gas analyser is available. ADA is a separate order (test.ada_pleural). No single LOINC panel, so orderLoinc is null. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Procalcitonin [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Sepsis and antibiotic stewardship. Mulago ICU and private labs; POC fluorescence kits exist. Malaria can raise PCT. minLevel is a judgement.

levelBasis.entry: FSH and LH; progesterone; testosterone; oestrogen
levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Order code left null because the moles term's status could not be confirmed (see gaps). Time to 7 days before expected menses.

orderLoinc.longName: Prolactin [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Sample at rest, ideally 2-3 h after waking. Stress, metoclopramide and antipsychotics raise it.

orderLoinc.longName: Prostate specific Ag [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Quantitative assay only; rapid qualitative strips are not this test. Avoid sampling soon after DRE, catheterisation, ejaculation or prostatitis. Level is a judgement (see gaps).

orderLoinc.longName: Prostate specific Ag panel - Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: % free is calculated by MedSync from the two measured values on the same platform. Most useful for total PSA 4-10 ng/mL.

orderLoinc.longName: Glucose [Moles/volume] in Capillary blood by Glucometer

tests.notes: Added so the most common glucose result in Uganda (bedside glucometer at every level) is not filed as a laboratory plasma glucose. Glucometers read poorly at very high and very low values and with abnormal haematocrit; confirm critical values in the lab where possible.

orderLoinc.longName: Glucose [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Venous plasma glucose run in the laboratory. A finger-prick glucometer reading should be ordered as test.glucose_capillary so lab and POC values are not mixed. A plain tube is acceptable only if separated within about 30 minutes.

orderLoinc.longName: Folate [Moles/volume] in Red Blood Cells

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Reflects longer-term status. Needs the same sample's haematocrit. Few labs offer it; serum folate is the usual substitute.

orderLoinc.longName: Salicylates [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Overdose. Rarely available; pair with a blood gas. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Angiotensin converting enzyme [Enzymatic activity/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Section 'clinical_chemistry' because it is an enzyme-activity assay, though ordered with immunology for sarcoidosis. Avoid EDTA (chelates the zinc the enzyme needs). Referral test; method- and kit-dependent ranges.

tests.container: Plain (red) or fluoride oxalate (grey); clean the skin with a non-alcohol swab

orderLoinc.longName: Ethanol [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Clinical use only (reduced consciousness, osmolal gap). Police use breathalysers; forensic blood alcohol is a separate chain-of-custody process. minLevel is a judgement.

tests.container: Plain (red), yellow/gold SST or lithium heparin (green)

orderLoinc.longName: Electrolytes 1998 panel - Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Electrolytes without urea and creatinine, often on a stand-alone ISE analyser. Bicarbonate and anion gap are reported only where the analyser measures CO2. minLevel is a judgement.

tests.display: Serum free light chains (kappa, lambda, ratio)

orderLoinc.longName: Immunoglobulin light chains.free panel - Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Part of the myeloma screen with SPEP and IFE. The ratio is calculated. Ranges are platform-specific and widen in CKD.

orderLoinc.longName: Immunofixation for Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Types the M-band (heavy and light chain). Usually done after a positive/equivocal SPEP; often sent out of country by private labs. Coded result, so no reference ranges apply.

orderLoinc.longName: Osmolality of Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Measured by an osmometer, which few Ugandan labs have. The calculated value and the gap need Na, urea and glucose from the same sample. Relevant to suspected methanol poisoning from illicit spirits, which has caused outbreaks in Uganda. minLevel is a judgement.

tests.container: Plain (red) or gold SST (not plasma - fibrinogen mimics a band)

orderLoinc.longName: Protein electrophoresis panel - Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Reuses v1 obs.total_protein. Fractions are derived from densitometry % x total protein. Serum is preferred because a plasma fibrinogen band can be mistaken for an M-band. Polyclonal gamma rise is common (HIV/chronic infection). A positive or equivocal band should prompt immunofixation.

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Dynamic test: tetracosactide 250 micrograms IV/IM after a baseline sample. Needs a clinician on the ward and timed samples, so the patient is usually referred (Mulago/private endocrine) rather than the sample. Pass cut-offs are assay-specific. LOINC has no generic panel code; component codes are not route-specific.

orderLoinc.longName: Testosterone [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.entry: FSH and LH; progesterone; testosterone; oestrogen
levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Morning sample for men. Used in female hirsutism/PCOS work-up, where immunoassay accuracy is poor at low levels.

tests.display: Thyroid function (total T3, total T4, TSH)

levelBasis.entry: Thyroid function (TSH, free T3, free T4, total T3, total T4)
levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Some private labs still offer total hormones. Free hormones are preferred, especially in pregnancy or on oestrogens. Hospitals may hide this test. No LOINC panel code matches.

levelBasis.entry: Thyroid function (TSH, free T3, free T4, total T3, total T4)
levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: Existing v1 test. LOINC has no TSH+FT4+FT3 panel code (24348-5 covers TSH+FT4 only). Done on immunoassay or fluorescence POC (FIA) analysers where reagents allow, otherwise sent to private labs. Biotin supplements interfere with many kits. Level is a judgement (see gaps).

orderLoinc.longName: Protein [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Usually part of LFTs; ordered alone for Light's criteria with a pleural tap.

orderLoinc.longName: Transferrin [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Rarely ordered alone; some labs report it in place of TIBC (TIBC is roughly transferrin g/L x 25).

tests.container: As kit specifies (often EDTA (purple) or plain (red))

orderLoinc.longName: Troponin I.cardiac [Presence] in Serum, Plasma or Blood by Rapid immunoassay

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Lateral-flow cassette, common in Ugandan EDs and private clinics. A negative result does not rule out MI early on. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Thyrotropin [Units/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.entry: Thyroid function (TSH, free T3, free T4, total T3, total T4)
levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: First-line thyroid screen and levothyroxine monitoring; Ugandan labs commonly allow TSH alone. Level is a judgement (see gaps).

orderLoinc.longName: Free T4 and TSH panel - Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.entry: Thyroid function (TSH, free T3, free T4, total T3, total T4)
levelBasis.note: Table 1 and narrative disagree; the lower level is used

tests.notes: The usual two-test thyroid order. The LOINC panel lists FT4 by mass; the moles concept is still a valid member result. Level is a judgement (see gaps).

tests.container: Plain (red), yellow/gold SST or lithium heparin (green)
tests.notes: Decision: in Uganda 'RFTs' are ordered as urea, creatinine, Na, K and Cl, which is the same thing as U&E, so RFT is an alias of this test rather than a second test (avoids duplicate orders and duplicate charges). Labs whose RFT also includes uric acid should add test.uric_acid alongside. Bicarbonate is blank on ISE-only analysers. eGFR is computed (CKD-EPI 2021), not measured. No single LOINC order code matches this panel, so orderLoinc is null. minLevel HC IV is a judgement: many HC IV labs have a semi-automated chemistry analyser, but it is often not working.

orderLoinc.longName: Urate [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Gout, pre-eclampsia work-up, tumour lysis. Some Ugandan labs include it in their 'RFTs'. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Albumin/Creatinine [Ratio] in Urine

tests.notes: Diabetes and hypertension kidney screening. v2 adds the measured urine albumin and urine creatinine before the v1 ratio concept so the lab can show its working; the v1 component is kept. Some NCD clinics use POC analysers. minLevel is a judgement.

tests.container: Universal urine container (sterile, screw-cap); 24 h bottle if requested

orderLoinc.longName: Immunoglobulin light chains [Presence] in Urine

tests.notes: Prefer urine electrophoresis/immunofixation. The heat-precipitation method still used in some labs is insensitive. Serum FLC is replacing urine testing for screening.

orderLoinc.longName: Drugs of abuse panel - Urine by Screen method

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Immunoassay multi-drug cassette (typically 6-12 lines); the lab ticks the lines its kit carries and the rest stay blank. Cut-offs are kit-specific. Results are presumptive; confirmation (mass spectrometry) is not available in-country for routine care. Butabika and RRH mental health units use these. Khat (cathinone) is not on standard cassettes. Results are sensitive; consider restricted viewing even though no restricted category fits. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Electrolytes 3 panel - Urine

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Hyponatraemia work-up and AKI (FENa). FENa is calculated only when serum Na and creatinine from the same time are on file. Chloride (in the LOINC panel) is not routinely reported in Uganda. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Osmolality of Urine

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Needs an osmometer (rare in Uganda). Interpret with serum osmolality. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Protein and creatinine panel - Urine

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Replaces 24-hour urine protein for most purposes (nephrotic syndrome, pre-eclampsia, lupus nephritis). Label the order 'uPCR' in full in the UI so it is not confused with PCR (molecular). minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Valproate [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Trough sample. minLevel is a judgement (Butabika / Mulago / private).

orderLoinc.longName: Vancomycin [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma --trough

tests.notes: Trough just before the 4th dose is the usual Ugandan order; timed levels for AUC dosing file as obs.vancomycin_random. Few labs in Uganda offer it. minLevel is a judgement.

orderLoinc.longName: Cobalamin (Vitamin B12) [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

tests.notes: Macrocytic anaemia and neuropathy work-up (including metformin users). Take before any B12 injection.

orderLoinc.longName: Cobalamin (Vitamin B12) and folate panel - Serum

tests.notes: The usual way macrocytosis is worked up. The LOINC panel lists mass-unit members; the moles concepts used here are equivalent results.

orderLoinc.longName: 25-Hydroxyvitamin D3+25-Hydroxyvitamin D2 [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Total 25-OH D (D2 + D3). Private labs do it often. Labs that report ng/mL use LOINC 62292-8.

tests.notes: Screen, titre if positive, and ICAP pattern. Reference method for ANA. Referred from public hospitals to private reference labs (e.g. Lancet, MBN) or Mulago/Makerere immunology; routing is a judgement, not a published menu.

tests.notes: More specific than RF for rheumatoid arthritis. Referred from public hospitals to private reference labs (e.g. Lancet, MBN) or Mulago/Makerere immunology; routing is a judgement, not a published menu.

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

tests.notes: Specific confirmation of a positive anti-dsDNA immunoassay. Rarely offered locally; usually sent abroad via private labs.

levelBasis.entry: Autoimmune panel (ANA, dsDNA, anti-CCP, ANCA, C3, C4)

levelBasis.note: Not on the 2017 national menu; strand judgement

orderLoinc.longName: HIV 1 and 2 Ab panel - Serum, Plasma or Blood by Rapid immunoassay

tests.notes: Serial algorithm per Uganda 2022 consolidated guidelines: Test 1 (screening), Test 2 (confirmatory), Test 3 (tie-breaker). Displays must say Test 1/2/3, never kit brands: kits change by MoH circular, so store the kit and lot per result as a method attribute and version the algorithm. Each RDT result can map to 80387-4 (HIV 1+2 Ab by rapid immunoassay). The order panel 89365-1 is verified, but its members (HIV-1 Ab, HIV-2 Ab, identifier) do not mirror T1/T2/T3, so use it as the order code only. Retest before ART is a separate visit/order.

No LOINC order code: 106883-2 'HIV1+2 Ab and Treponema pallidum Ab [Presence] in Serum, Plasma or Blood by Rapid immunoassay' (ACTIVE) is a single combined observation, not a panel. Suggest mapping the existing line concepts to 80387-4 (HIV line) and 106936-8 (syphilis line).
